# Jack Macdonald | Macdonald Group of Compass

> Jack Macdonald is a Bellevue native and REALTOR with Macdonald Group of Compass, helping people buy and sell homes across Bellevue, Kirkland, Redmond, Sammamish, Issaquah, North Bend, Fall City, Woodinville, and Bothell on the Eastside of Seattle, Washington. This site publishes monthly market reports, area guides, neighborhood guides, school district guides, city comparisons, and buyer and seller guides written from years of local experience.

Contact: 425.941.6998, 700 110th Ave NE, Suite 270, Bellevue, WA 98004. Washington license 21022645.

## Market reports (updated monthly)

* [Bellevue Home Values & Market Report | Updated October 2026](https://jackmacdonaldre.com/market-reports/bellevue/index.md): Bellevue's median single family sale price was $1.84 million for July to September 2026, up 2.3% from the same months last year. 266 single family homes sold (15.6% fewer than a year ago), and the median home spent 20 days on the market.
* [Redmond Home Values & Market Report | Updated October 2026](https://jackmacdonaldre.com/market-reports/redmond/index.md): Redmond's median single family sale price was $1.54 million for July to September 2026, down 2.4% from the same months last year. 93 single family homes sold (23.1% fewer than a year ago), and the median home spent 28 days on the market.
* [Kirkland Home Values & Market Report | Updated October 2026](https://jackmacdonaldre.com/market-reports/kirkland/index.md): Kirkland's median single family sale price was $1.37 million for July to September 2026, down 14.1% from the same months last year. 254 single family homes sold (10.9% more than a year ago), and the median home spent 23 days on the market.
* [Issaquah Home Values & Market Report | Updated October 2026](https://jackmacdonaldre.com/market-reports/issaquah/index.md): Issaquah's median single family sale price was $1.64 million for July to September 2026, up 9.0% from the same months last year. 61 single family homes sold (11.6% fewer than a year ago), and the median home spent 15 days on the market.
* [North Bend Home Values & Market Report | Updated October 2026](https://jackmacdonaldre.com/market-reports/north-bend/index.md): North Bend's median single family sale price was $1.30 million for July to September 2026, down 1.6% from the same months last year. 34 single family homes sold (15.0% fewer than a year ago), and the median home spent 22 days on the market. North Bend is a small market, so a few sales can move these numbers a lot.
* [Fall City Home Values & Market Report | Updated October 2026](https://jackmacdonaldre.com/market-reports/fall-city/index.md): Fall City's median single family sale price was $732,000 for July to September 2026. 6 single family homes sold, and the median home spent 22 days on the market. With this few sales, one or two homes can swing the median a long way, so read it as a rough guide, not a trend.

## Area guides

* [Bellevue area guide](https://jackmacdonaldre.com/areas/bellevue/): Bellevue is the Eastside's largest city, from the high rises downtown to established neighborhoods like Somerset, Newport Hills and Bridle Trails. I grew up here, so this is the market I know street by street.
* [Redmond area guide](https://jackmacdonaldre.com/areas/redmond/): Redmond runs from a fast growing, walkable downtown out to Education Hill, Overlake and Redmond Ridge. Light rail, Microsoft and the Lake Washington School District shape a lot of what buyers ask about here.
* [Kirkland area guide](https://jackmacdonaldre.com/areas/kirkland/): Kirkland pairs a lakefront downtown with very different neighborhoods a few minutes away, from Houghton and Rose Hill to Juanita and Finn Hill. It is one of the most requested areas on the Eastside for buyers who want to be near the water.
* [Issaquah area guide](https://jackmacdonaldre.com/areas/issaquah/): Issaquah sits at the edge of the Cascade foothills along I 90, with a historic downtown, the Issaquah Highlands, and hillside neighborhoods on Squak and Cougar Mountain. Trails start practically in town.
* [Sammamish area guide](https://jackmacdonaldre.com/areas/sammamish/): Sammamish is a plateau of mostly single family neighborhoods between Lake Sammamish and the foothills, served by both the Lake Washington and Issaquah school districts. Lots tend to be larger than in the closer in cities.
* [North Bend area guide](https://jackmacdonaldre.com/areas/north-bend/): North Bend is a small mountain town at the base of Mount Si, about 30 minutes east of Bellevue on I 90. Buyers come for space, acreage and the outdoors, and the trade off is the drive.
* [Fall City area guide](https://jackmacdonaldre.com/areas/fall-city/): Fall City is an unincorporated river community along the Snoqualmie River between Issaquah, Snoqualmie and Carnation. Homes here are often on larger rural lots, and the market is small, so every sale moves the numbers.
